device_observation: Dismissal freezing is gone. Previews, including the first preview, do not interrupt other playing audio.
acceptance_scope: Device confirmation of dismissal latency and first-preview/repeated-preview external-audio preservation fixes.
interpretation: Exact source/proof/donor match. Six source requests, loads, playing observations, decoded-video observations, retirements and closes; no playback errors, failures or mute mismatches. Native root and navigation guard remain owned. All 25 runtime probes record zero hits, but baseline calibration is false, so this report does not independently establish calibrated runtime absence. Main pause maximum 36 us; main detach maximum 309 us; worker SDK release maximum 299 us; background audio preparation/promotion maximum 872482 us and restoration maximum 626192 us. These are bounded stage timings, not end-to-end frame measurements or direct recordings of external audio. External-audio continuity and absence of freezing are device observations. No background event is recorded, so background/account-loss behavior is not newly validated here.
